methods: Every source_trace joins connected source ports and named source nets in an independently constructed DSU.
SMT rectangles/polygons/circles, rotated pill/circle PTH lands, all-through barrels, maximum-adjacent-width swept trace segments and exact native BREP pours are checked on every occupied layer.

Layer-specific drilled voids are subtracted from every conductor before overlap measurement; polygon circle approximation uses 1024 edges. Analytic trace/trace, via/via and via/trace centerline gap calculations preserve continuous round copper extents.
STRtree dwithin=.251 mm searches every native copper pair. Net identity exemptions depend on source graph roots, never matching labels, accepted pass flags or expected rendered appearance.
limitations: Ideal native CAD geometry only; soldermask, etch/drill tolerances and bench continuity are outside this short check.
Unknown copper objects are reported and retain unique foreign roots, so isolated fiducials do not silently share a net.
No declared trace/trace, pour/trace, pour/pad or pour/pour clearance field exists; their .20 mm proximity screening is explicitly distinguished from board policy.
